title: Dual-Thrust Switching Analytical Guidance Algorithm for Powered Landing with Attitude Smoothness Optimization
summary: Traditional numerical guidance methods for powered landing of reusable rockets are typically constrained by high computational complexity and inadequate real-time performance. Moreover, insufficient consideration of attitude smoothness often induces severe fluctuations in control commands; meanwhile, most existing approaches are tailored for single-thrust scenarios, failing to accommodate the guidance requirements of multi-engine thrust switching.
